name: The Ren & Stimpy Show
description: Ren and Stimpy are a mismatch made in animation heaven with nothing in common but a life-long friendship and an incredible knack for getting into trouble. Join them in their bizarre and gross world for some outlandish situations coupled with hilarious jokes.

videos.title: Big House Blues (Unedited Pilot)
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy get tossed in the pound and find themselves next in line for... the Big Sleep! Will someone adopt them in time? Or will Ren lose his mind first?

videos.title: Sammy and Me
videos.overview: Stimpy's Sammy Mantis Jr. fan club kit arrives in the mail, and Stimpy is overjoyed.

videos.title: The Last Temptation
videos.overview: Stimpy gets paranoid because he's used up eight of his lives and only has one left to live.

videos.title: Man's Best Friend
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy learn the true meaning of obedience when George Liquor takes them home with him and swears to make them "champions." Nickelodeon refused to air this episode as it was considered too violent and sadistic for kids. It was also taken off the British Ren and Stimpy DVD. It was later aired as an episode of Spike's "Ren and Stimpy Adult Party Cartoon".

videos.title: Sven Höek Pencil Test
videos.overview: An early version of the episode Sven Höek, drawn in pencil.

videos.title: Col. Backwash's Chicken in a Drawer
FLOD The Most Perfect Cube of Fat
Stimpy's Big Day
videos.overview: Ren thinks TV has ruined Stimpy's mind, but when Stimpy wins a televised Gritty Kitty Litter contest and becomes a Hollywood star on the Muddy Muddskipper show, he leaves Ren behind.

videos.title: The Big Shot
videos.overview: While Stimpy enjoys his new found success in show business, Ren sits at home missing his brainless buddy. Will Stimpy give up his fame and fortune to return home?

videos.title: Robin Höek
videos.overview: Ren dreams that he is the hero of Stimpy's bedtime story - a brave outlaw who robs from the rich, gives to the criminally insane, and rescues the cross-dressed cat, Maid Moron.

videos.title: Nurse Stimpy
videos.overview: When Ren falls ill, it's Nurse Stimpy to the rescue, swearing by the Sacred Bedpan to cure his friend. Will the constant care lead to a cured Chihuahua, or a total relapse?

videos.title: Space Madness
videos.overview: During a 36-year mission to the Crab Nebula, Commander Höek succumbs to Space Madness and puts Cadet Stimpy in charge of the mysterious History Eraser Button!

videos.title: The Boy Who Cried Rat!
videos.overview: Penniless and hungry, Ren hatches the perfect plan: Stimpy can get work as a family's mouse-catching kitty, and Ren can pose as the mouse. What could possibly go wrong?

videos.title: Big House Blues
videos.overview: The pilot episode of Nickelodeon's series, The Ren & Stimpy Show.

videos.title: The Littlest Giant
videos.overview: During the story of "The Littlest Giant," Ren drifts off and dreams that he is Wee Ren, a resident of Thumbsville who makes the mistake of befriending the littlest Giant, Stimpy.

videos.title: Fire Dogs
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy need new jobs, so they disguise themselves as Dalmatians, go to work for a psychotic fire chief, and battle a 40-story building fire, saving Mr. Horse and others!

videos.title: Marooned
videos.overview: In this space adventure, Commander Höek and Cadet Stimpy land on an eerie planet with only their Space Cadet Handbook to guide them! Can they avoid certain doom? Nope.

videos.title: A Cartoon
videos.overview: Nature show host "Marlon" Höek and his sidekick Stimpy explore a strange Galapagos Island chain where all species look like Ren and Stimpy... but even less evolved!

videos.title: Black Hole
videos.overview: It's another warped day for Commander Höek and Cadet Stimpy as they fly into a mind-bending black hole, mutate continuously, and discover a mountain of missing left socks.

videos.title: Stimpy's Invention
videos.overview: Stimpy invents a Happy Helmet so that his foaming friend Ren can be happy all the time. But it pushes Ren way past happiness and into utter insanity - and the nonstop "Happy, Happy, Joy, Joy" song doesn't help either!

videos.title: In the Army
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy join the Army, where they begin basic training under a very demanding Drill Sargent.

videos.title: Powdered Toastman
videos.overview: We then follow the unusual and bizarre adventures of "Powdered Toast Man" as he is called on for various rescue missions.

videos.title: Ren's Toothache
videos.overview: Ren learns the benefits of dental hygiene the hard way, as he refuses to listen to Stimpy's advice on brushing your teeth.

videos.title: Out West
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy find themselves amid the Wild West, where they run up against a Sheriff and Deputy who's favorite past-time is hanging people.

videos.title: Rubber Nipple Salesmen
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy hit the road as door-to-door Rubber Nipple Salesmen, peddling their wares to a bizarre clientele, including a psychotic Fire Chief, a paranoid Mr. Horse, and a family actually in need of new nipples!

videos.title: Svën Höek
videos.overview: Ren gets driven out of his mind yet again as his anxiously awaited cousin Svën forms a stupidity bond with Stimpy through magic Nose Goblins, Kitty Litter, and the "Don't Whiz on the Electric Fence" board game.

videos.title: Haunted House
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy visit a haunted mansion where a depressive ghost fruitlessly tries to scare them, but the clueless duo barely notice his antic... not even the chainsaw!

videos.title: Mad Dog Höek
videos.overview: The fearsome Lout Brothers take on Mad Dog Höek (Ren) and Killer Kadoogan (Stimpy) in a no-holds-barred wrestling match that tests Ren's theory on how fake wrestling is.

videos.title: Big Baby Scam
videos.overview: It's Ren's greatest scheme ever: switch places with a couple of babies and enjoy the pampered life. But being babies turns out to be harder than Ren or Stimpy ever imagined.

videos.title: Dog Show
videos.overview: George Liquor, American, has worked tirelessly to groom Ren and Stimpy for the All County Dog Show, but before they can compete, they'll need to get past the toughest judge of all - Mr. Horse!

videos.title: Monkey See, Monkey Don't
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy want the easy life of living in a zoo. They disguise themselves as monkeys and try to hang in there.

videos.title: Fake Dad
videos.overview: Ren shows his soft side when he volunteers to be a fake dad for a 200-pound prison convict named Kowalski. Of course, Stimpy lends support as the loving fake mom.

videos.title: The Great Outdoors
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy go camping and learn how to rough it in nature. And what could be rougher than skinny dipping with Stimpy? Ren's about to find out.

videos.title: The Cat that Laid the Golden Hairball
videos.overview: Ren has a new way to strike it rich - sell Stimpy's hairballs! Stimpy starts hwarfing hairballs on a production line, but what will Ren do when the supply runs out?

videos.title: Stimpy's Fan Club
videos.overview: Ren is jealous of Stimpy's constant stream of fan mail, so Stimpy makes his pal the president of his Fan Club, causing Ren delusions of grandeur, and ultimately, insanity.

videos.title: A Visit to Anthony
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy's U.S. visit to a young fan named Anthony threatens to destroy all his youthful fantasies, so Anthony's overprotective father threatens to destroy them!

videos.title: The Royal Canadian Kilted Yaksmen
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy become Royal Canadian Kilted Yaksmen and brave the jungle, desert, and snow of Canada, facing hunger, poison dirt, a Kodiak Marmoset, and a catchy tune!

videos.title: To Salve and Salve Not!
videos.overview: A salesman keeps bugging Stimpy to buy a new product, Salve. Ren gets very annoyed and tries to get him out of his house, but when he finally needs it, Stimpy buys all the cans of Salve.

videos.title: A Yard Too Far
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy try to get food from a house (Yogi Bear-style) with a baboon guarding it.

videos.title: Circus Midgets
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy have been hitch hiking for three years. They finally get a ride... from crazed circus midgets who kidnap various people, because they are in desperate need of an audience.

videos.title: No Pants Today
videos.overview: After Stimpy gets out of the shower, he finds that there is not a pair of pants in the house. Ignoring Ren, who tells him that clothes are for humans, and that he doesn't need pants, he tries multiple times to find a pair of pants, without much luck. He is shunned by the outside world because he is nude. He eventually gets lost in the forest, cold, naked, and embarrassed.

videos.title: Son of Stimpy
videos.overview: Stimpy squeezes, and a stench is born. Ren thinks it's just a stinky fantasy, but when Stinky floats away, Stimpy abandons his friend to search through rain and snow and dark of night. It'll take a Christmas miracle for Stinky to return to his warm, snugly home!

videos.title: Ren's Pecs
videos.overview: Beach-hound Ren is busy strutting his stuff for the babes of summer when a huge hairy bully kicks sand in his face.

videos.title: An Abe Divided
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy volunteer to take care of the Lincoln Memorial, until they break the head of the monument.

videos.title: Stimpy's Cartoon Show
videos.overview: Stimpy is making a cartoon when Ren appears and tries to persuade Stimpy that cartoons aren't good for the brain. When Stimpy discovers that Ren is bad for drawing he makes him producer of the cartoon. Ren takes over the credits of the cartoon and Stimpy works in a slavering way until the cartoon is finished and are invited to show the cartoon to Wilbur Cobb, "the godfather of animation".

videos.title: Jimminy Lummox
videos.overview: Stimpy walks in on Ren while he tortures an ant. After concluding that Ren has no conscience, Stimpy lets Ren borrow his concience, played by guitar player Jiminy Lummox.

videos.title: Bass Masters
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy are the hosts of a popular fishing show. They set out on a mission to catch the legendary foul mouth Bass, Albert, and Wilbur Cobb escapes from prison to come along with them.

videos.title: Road Apples
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy pose as roadkill so they can get a ride to the desert.

videos.title: Ren's Retirement
videos.overview: Ren's feeling fine on his 10th birthday until Stimpy reminds him that he's 70 years old in "dog years". Ren prepares for death with a will, a fake funeral, and the search for the perfect coffin.

videos.title: Jerry the Bellybutton Elf
videos.overview: Stimpy's playing with his belly button until he gets inside of it and meets an elf named Jerry.

videos.title: Hard Times for Haggis
videos.overview: Haggis MacHaggis is the host of a popular kids show - that is, until Ren and Stimpy hits the air.

videos.title: Eat my cookies
videos.overview: Desperate to join the Barrette Beret Girls, Ren and Stimpy have to prove themselves to the burly babes.

videos.title: Ren's Bitter Half
videos.overview: Stimpy creates a cloning liquid in his lab, and it falls into Ren's hands.

videos.title: Lair of the Lummox
videos.overview: As hosts of their favorite TV show, Untamed World, Ren & Stimpy become voyeurs in the wild.

videos.title: Hermit Ren
videos.overview:
Annoyed by Stimpy's stupidity, Ren goes to live off as a hermit, and goes crazy after months of being alone. He is kicked out of the hermits union for having imaginary friends.

Segment: Untamed World: Field Guide - Stimpy, reprising his role as a nature show host from Untamed World, in the jungles of Miami, Florida.

videos.title: House of Next Tuesday
videos.overview: The chums seek refuge in a model home of the future which is awash with rare conveniences.

videos.title: A Friend in Your Face!
videos.overview: Stimpy has a friend in his face (like a tick), then Ren ends up with the friend's friend, which starts to annoy him to no end.

videos.title: Blazing Entrails
videos.overview: Ren goes into Stimpy's body to find a medical explanation to why he is so stupid.

videos.title: Lumber-Jerks
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy get jobs as Paper Boys, but nobody is paying their bills.

videos.title: Prehistoric Stimpy
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy go to the Natural History Museum to see the skeletal remains of the mammoth Stimpysaurus.

videos.title: Farm Hands
videos.overview: Famished, Ren & Stimpy pretend to be long lost children of two Farmers.

videos.title: Magical Golden Singing Cheeses
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy are two starving peasants in a fairy-tale world, so Stimpy tries to wrangle some wheels of magic singing cheese from the village idiot by besting him in a contest of stupidity.

videos.title: A Hard Days Luck
videos.overview: Haggis McHaggis finds a leprechaun in his breakfast cereal, but before he can get a wish from the wee man, he has to prove he's even-tempered, generous, and brave (or at least one of the three). Like that's going to happen...

videos.title: I Love Chicken
videos.overview: Stimpy is preparing Dinner for Ren, until Stimpy falls in love with a Chicken.

videos.title: Powdered Toast Man vs. Waffle Woman
videos.overview: A woman tells the story of how her waffle business was ruined because of Powdered Toast. Meanwhile Powdered Toast Man tries to grant a wish for Little Jimmy.

videos.title: It's a Dog's Life
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy are about to take that last long walk at the dog pound when a sweet rich old lady falls for them and adopts them.

videos.title: Ren & Stimpy Present Egg Yölkeo
videos.overview: In this parody of Pinocchio, Renwaldo, the village of Egg Smithëe, makes a puppet boy name Egg Yölkeo.

videos.title: Double Header
videos.overview: Ren can't stand Stimpy anymore, so he sends Stimpy on a one-way ticket out of town. Then they are hit by a bus and get united (literally) in a cheap hospital.

videos.title: The Scotsman in Space
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy take off on an exciting Space adventure, starring the scotsman Haggis.

videos.title: Pixie King
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy find themselves in elf & gnome world where everyone happily works to graduate to Pixie status.

videos.title: Aloha Höek
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy are marooned & starving on a deserted island. They find a dead whale and start living inside it. Later Ren kicks Stimpy out of the rotting whale and Stimpy finds "Big Kahuna", a nice fat man who has food, a hut and girls with him.

videos.title: Insomaniac Ren
videos.overview: All Ren wants to do is sleep but his insomnia isn't letting him...

videos.title: My Shiny Friend
videos.overview: Stimpy won't stop watching television.

videos.title: Cheese Rush Days
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy journey to the Blue-Cheese Mountains to become miners.

videos.title: Wiener Barons
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy stumble upon a vast supply of wieners, while becoming Wiener Barons of Canada.

videos.title: Galoot Wranglers
videos.overview: Wilbur Cobb tells Ren and Stimpy a Western story about galoots.

videos.title: Ren Needs Help!
videos.overview: After Stimpy breaks Ren's stuff, Ren goes crazy and is sent to a home for mentally insane people.

videos.title: Ol' Blue Nose
videos.overview: Ren hits Stimpy in the nose and he starts to sing with a crooner-like voice. Stimpy becames famous, until his nose leaves him because of being slapped many times.

videos.title: Stupid Sidekick Union
videos.overview: The sidekick union is going on a massive strike and Stimpy is alerted.

videos.title: Superstitious Stimpy
videos.overview: Stimpy becomes superstitious when Tuesday the 17th arrives.

videos.title: Travelogue
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy travel to a new Country.

videos.title: Space Dogged
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy are going to be the first dog and cat sent up to space in the Russian space program

videos.title: Feud For Sale
videos.overview: In the spirit of the Hatfields and McCoys, Ren and Stimpy present the Nitwits and the Dimwits.

videos.title: Hair of the Cat
videos.overview: Ren is suffering from horrible allergies. Little does he know that he may be allergic to his best pal Stimpy.

videos.title: City Hicks
videos.overview: Ren & Stimpy leave the country when it rains & their fields are ruined with fruits & vegetables.

videos.title: Stimpy's Pet
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy find an abandoned circus clown at their doorstep. While Ren DOES NOT want to keep him, Stimpy pleads and begs until Ren agrees.

videos.title: Ren's Brain
videos.overview: Ren's status as Lord of the Manor is challenged.Stimpy the mad scientist replaces Ren's brain.

videos.title: Bellhops
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy get jobs as bellhops and must make sure that no one finds out who is living in the top two floors of the hotel, but their curiosity gets the best of them.

videos.title: Dog Tags
videos.overview: Ren is getting ready for the annual Dog Lodge meeting and Stimpy begs to come along (due to the fact that the lodge is for dogs only since he's a cat) in which Ren agrees to bring him to the Dog Lodge.

videos.title: I Was a Teenage Stimpy
videos.overview: Stimpy starts his journey into teenagedom, complete with all of its trials & tribulations.

videos.title: Who's Stupid Now?
videos.overview: When Ren and Stimpy find out they are about to be cancelled, Ren comments that they'll do anything to keep the show on going, so the producer makes "a twist in chemistry" by making Stimpy the skinny jerk and Ren as the fat idiot.

videos.title: School Mates
videos.overview: An old obedience school friend of Ren's comes over for a surprise visit & is appalled that Ren is living a middle class lifestyle with a house cat.

videos.title: Dinner Party
videos.overview: Ren Höek narrates the proper etiquette for throwing a dinner party.

videos.title: Big Flakes
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy are watching TV when they see the grand opening of a new jail where the prisoners are treated like kings.

videos.title: Pen Pals
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy are snowed in. Stimpy amuses himself with watching dark TV, whistling in a bottle and other mundane activities.

videos.title: Terminal Stimpy
videos.overview: Stimpy gets paranoid because he's used up eight of his lives and only has one left to live.

videos.title: Reverend Jack
videos.overview: Ren and Stimpy begin a job working for the Reverend Jack Cheese in his meat mobile.

videos.title: A Scooter For Yaksmas
videos.overview: Stimpy believes in Yaksmas, yet Ren who thinks Yaksmas is stupid, doesn't believe in the festive holiday.

country: United States, Canada, Australia, Taiwan, South Korea
awards: Nominated for 3 Primetime Emmys. 1 win & 12 nominations total
